about: If your car’s refrigerant leaks or A/C systems break down, you’ll not be able to drive in hot weather on UAE roads. The leakage of refrigerant is not only harmful to environment but also harmful to your car and health. Car’s refrigerant leakage can damage your car’s ac compressor and evaporator. Get your car’s air conditioning service as soon as you notice the problem in cooling to save your money.

At Al Jazeera Autos the A/C performance check is carried out by qualified auto technicians who are highly skilled to examine all types of low to heavy duty Automobile vehicle’s air conditioning system to find out any refrigerant leakage and repair it to avoid any further issues. UAE temperatures rise in summers so get your car’s air conditioner serviced to fix and enjoy refreshing drive.
